nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=68 beats='Miri unlocks the school garden gate on the first morning of holiday week with the feed scoop under one arm; she counts hens and reaches only two, big rusty Marigold and speckled Dumpling; the smallest hen Pip is gone; the straw on one side of the coop is flat and cold; Miri makes herself breathe slowly and look properly'>>

choices.label: Look closely at the coop door
Search the wet grass for feathers

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Miri kneels at the green coop door and finds the wooden latch swung up and resting sideways instead of pushed down; a scrape of mud crosses the sill and points out into the garden; she remembers shutting the door at dusk but not whether she pressed the latch hard; Marigold and Dumpling crowd her boots and grumble for breakfast'>>

choices.label: Count the eggs in the nest box

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Miri walks the wet grass in a slow circle the way Mr Osei taught her, eyes down, no running; one soft grey feather is caught on the wire fence and a second lies further along near the steaming compost heap; Biscuit the neighbour cat watches from the top of the wall with a very flat tail and a very round belly'>>

choices.label: Follow the feathers to the fence

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='Miri runs two streets home and shakes Theo awake; he pulls wellies on over pyjamas, grabs his bent torch and a paper bag of corn, and asks eleven questions about Pip before they reach the gate; Miri answers every single one, and by the last one she is thinking clearly again'>>

choices.label: Split the garden into two teams

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='At the bottom corner of the fence the wire is pushed up into a small bent arch, exactly wide enough for one small hen; grey down clings to the cut end of it; beyond the arch lie the allotment rows, the thick hedge, and a long brown puddle; the pliers that could flatten the arch hang on their hook in the shed'>>

choices.label: Fetch the pliers and mend it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='Miri lifts the nest box lid and counts what is inside; four brown eggs are cool and one small pale egg is still warm under the straw; only Pip lays the pale ones, and warm means Pip sat right here not very long ago, which means she cannot have gone far at all'>>

choices.label: Hunt the dark corners near the coop

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='The tool shed door hangs open a hand width and inside it smells of oil and dry soil; the old mower sits under a folded grey blanket, a tower of flowerpots leans against the window, and somewhere near the floor something rustles once and then stops; Miri holds the torch steady with both hands and listens hard'>>

choices.label: Go back to the nest box
Send Theo to the bike rack

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='The compost heap steams gently in the cold air and one side of it has been scratched into a shallow dip; broken shell and cabbage stalks lie kicked about; a line of small three toed prints leads away from the dip toward the hedge and stops at a flattened gap in the bottom of it'>>

choices.label: Follow the prints into the hedge

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='Miri climbs the low wall and sits down beside Biscuit, who is fat and slow and washing one paw with enormous care; there is no feather on his whiskers and no guilt anywhere in his face; from up here Miri can see the whole allotment, the bean rows, and the bent corner of the wire fence'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Miri tears a page from the hen notebook and draws the garden as a map with squares for the shed, the coop, and the bike rack; she gives Theo the near half and takes the far half; they agree to shout the word FOUND and nothing else, and to meet back at the willow tree either way'>>

choices.label: Let Theo check the bike rack

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Miri stands where the school garden ends and the allotment begins; long runner bean rows run away in green stripes, a watering can lies tipped on its side in the corner by the water butt, and a thicket of brambles hunches against the far fence; from here every single row looks exactly the same'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='The hedge hides a low tunnel worn smooth by foxes and lost footballs; Miri crawls in and all the light turns green; halfway along, the tunnel splits, one way scratching toward the brambles and one way toward a soft steady sound she cannot name yet; twigs snag her jumper and hold on'>>

choices.label: Back out to the bean rows

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Miri takes the pliers off the shed hook and walks the fence until she finds the bent arch of wire in the bottom corner; she squeezes it flat and wedges a paving slab along the bottom so nothing can push under it again; the fence is safe now, but Pip is still on the wrong side of it'>>

choices.label: Wait quietly by the mended gap

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Miri holds the warm pale egg in both hands and tries to think like a hen instead of like a girl; Pip loves places that are dark and low and dry and fit exactly one bird; the tipped watering can in the allotment corner is dark and low, and so is the folded blanket over the old mower'>>

choices.label: Lift the blanket on the mower

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Miri squeezes past the mower handle with the torch gripped in her teeth; behind it sits a bundle of grey blanket with a dent pressed into the middle, a puddle of old oil, and a trail of dry soil crossing the floor toward the doorway and the bike rack outside; up near the roof a small flap swings'>>

choices.label: Follow the soil to the bikes

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=64 beats='Theo comes back at a run with his report; the bike rack has a puddle under it and three grey feathers stuck to a wet frame; he has already shouted the word FOUND twice by mistake and says sorry both times; small wet footprints lead out of the puddle, and they go in two directions at once'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Biscuit lets Miri lift him down and then shows her where he sleeps, a warm shelf under the shed roof reached through a swinging flap; the flap hangs crooked and one grey feather is caught in its hinge; then Biscuit strolls off toward the brambles with his tail straight up, plainly expecting to be followed'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Miri telephones Mr Osei the caretaker from the school office phone; he is halfway through his toast and says he will come in ten minutes with the clipboard and a roll of spare wire; first he asks Miri to shut Marigold and Dumpling safely in, so that nobody else can go wandering while they look'>>

choices.label: Walk the fence with Mr Osei

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Miri walks the bean rows one at a time, making the small chirrup that Pip always answers; three rows give her nothing but bees; in the fourth row the leaves shiver against the wind and a beak pokes out through them; Pip is dusty and cross and completely alive, standing over a hollow she has scratched in the warm soil'>>

choices.label: Lift Pip out of the leaves

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='The green watering can lies on its side in the corner with straw dragged into its wide mouth; Miri crouches down and looks along the spout, and two bright round eyes look straight back at her; there is straw, there is a warm dusty smell, and there is something small and pale tucked underneath the hen'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='The bramble thicket is a black tangle of thorns with one low arch worn into the bottom of it; deep inside, a grey shape shifts and grumbles to itself; Miri cannot reach in without tearing her arms, so it is either elbows and a slow careful crawl, or a line of corn laid out into the open grass'>>

choices.label: Crawl in and reach for Pip
Lay a corn trail and step back

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=66 beats='The fence corner is patched and the garden goes very quiet; Miri sits on the upturned bucket with the feed scoop and a handful of corn, rattling it slowly so it sounds like every other feeding time; Marigold and Dumpling answer from the coop, and Miri decides that being still is a kind of searching too'>>

choices.label: Wait right up to feeding time

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Miri stops walking and shuts her eyes so that her ears can do the work; the sound comes again, a low burbling cluck from behind the water butt, where a hen sized hollow has been scratched out of the fallen leaves; Pip is muttering to herself the way she always does when she is settling down'>>

choices.label: Lift Pip out of the hollow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Miri peels the folded blanket back one corner at a time, the way you open a present you are not sure about; underneath is a nest of straw and grey dust with Pip sitting low and puffed in the middle of it; she does not bolt and she does not squawk, she growls one small warning growl and stays put'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=64 beats='The wet prints under the bike rack go two ways, one set toward the gate and one set back toward the coop, and both are smudged where Theo stood in them; there is no honest way to tell which set is newer; the morning is turning warm and the prints are drying paler while Miri looks at them'>>

choices.label: Follow the prints to the gate
Go back and wait by the coop

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=66 beats='Mr Osei arrives with his clipboard, a roll of spare wire, and absolutely no hurry; he walks the whole fence line beside Miri and marks three weak places with chalk crosses, then asks her exactly what she saw and when, and writes down every answer in his neat square caretaker letters while she talks'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='The crooked flap under the shed roof swings both ways and its hinge is holding one grey feather; behind it the shelf is warm and dark and exactly hen sized; Miri lifts the flap with one finger and finds straw dragged into a neat ring, with Pip sitting inside the ring and blinking at the torchlight'>>

choices.label: Make the shed safe for hens
Write down what Pip taught her

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Miri sits down in the wet grass and makes herself completely still, corn flat on her palm and no sudden words at all; Pip watches, tips her head twice, then walks out and steps up onto the hand; Miri carries her back slowly, pushes the wooden latch all the way down, and hears three hens grumbling together again'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Miri pulls her jumper sleeve over one hand and scoops Pip up in a careful two handed hold, wings tucked in and feet dangling; Pip complains the entire way across the garden and stops the instant she smells the feed scoop; Marigold and Dumpling shout at her as though she has been gone a whole year'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='With Pip safely inside, Miri walks the fence line one more time and mends every weak corner with spare wire and paving slabs; she pushes the latch down and then pulls it twice to be sure; the last thing she does before locking the gate is count the hens out loud, one and two and three'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Miri stops chasing and does the ordinary thing instead; she stands at the coop door and rattles the feed scoop exactly the way she does every single evening; nothing happens for a long slow minute, and then the bean leaves shake and Pip comes bustling out across the grass, cross and dusty and perfectly fine'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Miri lifts Pip up and finds five small pale eggs in a scooped hollow of straw underneath her; Pip never ran away at all, she was keeping a secret; Miri carries hen and eggs back together, writes SECRET NEST in the hen notebook, and adds a line telling the next keeper to search hidden corners first'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Miri searches until the sun is high and finds nothing but old feathers and her own footprints going round in circles; at teatime Mr Osei telephones, because Pip was asleep in the allotment shed the whole time; Miri is glad and tired and a little bit cross with herself for looking everywhere twice and nowhere carefully'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Pip is back on her perch and the garden is quiet again, and Miri sits on the upturned bucket with a pencil and the notebook; she rules three columns headed latch, count, and gaps, and writes the date at the top of the page; it is not a heroic ending, but it is the one that stops the next missing morning'>>
